source.chapter: BPHS chapters on the effects of the Vimshottari dashas; Phaladeepika ch. 19-20 (dasha results)
source.note: Classical meanings restated in plain words for this app. Check against a verified edition before relying on them.

condition: `general` applies to every dasha of the planet; `strong` when the planet is exalted or in its own sign (Rahu/Ketu: in the 3rd, 6th or 11th house); `weak` when it is debilitated, in an enemy's sign, or (Rahu/Ketu) in the 6th, 8th or 12th house.

rules.general: When the Sun's dasa begins you become more confident and ambitious and want to be seen and respected. Matters of government, authority, the father and recognition come forward; you may travel and deal with people in power. Look after the eyes, heart and digestion, and keep pride in check.
rules.strong: Because the Sun is strong in your horoscope, this period brings status, promotion, respect from those in authority and gains through your own leadership. Your father may rise in life or support you.
rules.weak: Because the Sun is weak in your horoscope, ego clashes, trouble with superiors or worries about the father's health may arise. Guard your vitality and avoid confrontations with authority.

rules.general: During the Moon's dasa the mind becomes more sensitive, caring and devotional. Home, mother, travel, the public and emotional life are prominent, and comforts such as good food, flowers and pleasant company increase. Rest well and look after fluids and digestion.
rules.strong: Because the Moon is strong in your horoscope, this period brings peace of mind, popularity, pleasant travel, a rise in status or income and happy family events.
rules.weak: Because the Moon is weak in your horoscope, the mind may become restless or anxious; care for your emotional balance and for your mother's health.

rules.general: During Mars' dasa you become energetic, bold and decisive. Property, land, vehicles, siblings, competition and technical work come forward. Avoid haste, anger, accidents and quarrels.
rules.strong: Because Mars is strong in your horoscope, you gain property, win over rivals and progress in technical, defence or managerial roles, with the courage to take bold steps.
rules.weak: Because Mars is weak in your horoscope, disputes, injuries, blood-related problems or losses through haste are possible; act calmly and drive carefully.

rules.general: During Mercury's dasa learning, communication, trade and friendships flourish. You may study, write, travel for work or start business ventures, and your wit and adaptability help you.
rules.strong: Because Mercury is strong in your horoscope, this period brings success in studies, business, writing and accounts, with good friends and quick gains.
rules.weak: Because Mercury is weak in your horoscope, nervous strain, misunderstandings or losses in trade are possible; read agreements carefully.

rules.general: During Jupiter's dasa wisdom, faith and good fortune grow. Children, teachers, higher learning, wealth and religious activities come forward, and people respect your counsel.
rules.strong: Because Jupiter is strong in your horoscope, this is one of the best periods of life: prosperity, progress of children, honours and spiritual growth.
rules.weak: Because Jupiter is weak in your horoscope, growth is slower; avoid over-confidence and excess, and look after the liver and weight.

rules.general: During Venus' dasa comforts, relationships, arts and pleasures increase. Marriage, vehicles, ornaments, beauty and social life come forward, and you enjoy refined surroundings.
rules.strong: Because Venus is strong in your horoscope, this period brings a happy married life, wealth, vehicles, artistic success and luxuries.
rules.weak: Because Venus is weak in your horoscope, relationships may be strained and spending on luxuries may get out of hand; practise moderation.

rules.general: During Saturn's dasa life asks for discipline, patience and hard work. Responsibilities grow, progress may feel slow, and you deal with older people, labour and long-term projects; what you build now lasts.
rules.strong: Because Saturn is strong in your horoscope, steady effort brings authority, property, a stable career and recognition later in the period.
rules.weak: Because Saturn is weak in your horoscope, delays, fatigue, chronic health issues or heavy burdens may arise; a regular routine and service to others help.

rules.general: During Rahu's dasa ambition and restlessness increase. Unconventional opportunities, foreign connections, technology and sudden changes come forward; stay grounded and ethical.
rules.strong: Because Rahu is well placed in your horoscope, a sudden rise, gains from abroad and success in large organisations or new fields are possible.
rules.weak: Because Rahu is afflicted in your horoscope, confusion, deception or health scares are possible; avoid shortcuts and verify information.

rules.general: During Ketu's dasa the mind turns inward. Spiritual interests, research, detachment and unexpected changes come forward, and worldly matters may feel less important.
rules.strong: Because Ketu is well placed in your horoscope, this period brings insight, spiritual progress, success in technical or research work and freedom from old burdens.
rules.weak: Because Ketu is afflicted in your horoscope, confusion, sudden losses or minor health problems may occur; meditation and patience help.
